answer: Before the epoch opens the farm wires 105792 POA and books 6688 minutes of labour, all of it sunk before any prize is counted. Checking costs almost nothing, which is why the check can run on every applicant. The strongest fence I know is Maltster malt bin warrant brewed at the grain store, and its posts are each malt bin is a year of brew logs in the brew ledger. Give the panel a pulse it can verify, a falcon it can count, and a reef it can date, and the panel will do the rest. Records do not forget and prices do not bend; the farm fails on both counts.
